---
title: "Overall survival with unrestricted follow-up — non-PH fitting"
subtitle: "Supporting time-varying treatment-effect analysis using five imputations"
format: html
---

- `rstanarm` default priors, not the SAP priors of the main model.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(rstanarm)
library(survival)
library(mice)
library(here)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))

results_dir <- here(
  "analysis", "02-overall-survival", "04-unrestricted-follow-up", "results"
)
model_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "nph", "models")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

indices <- seq_len(config$imputation$m_supporting)
imputations <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "imputations.rds"))
```

## Fitting

```{r}
#| label: fit-nph-models
#| include: false

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))

  if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
    fitting_data <- complete(imputations, index) |>
      mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2)) |>
      # Zero follow-up is dropped from fitting only; standardization keeps it.
      filter_out(survival_time_days_unrestricted == 0)

    model <- stan_surv(
      formula = Surv(
        survival_time_days_unrestricted,
        status_death_unrestricted
      ) ~ tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3) +
        ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
      data = fitting_data,
      chains = 4L,
      iter = 1000L,
      warmup = 500L,
      cores = 4L,
      basehaz = "ms",
      basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
      seed = config$seeds$supporting + (index - 1) * 1000 + 900
    )

    saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
  }
}
```
